name: quake-news-agent
description: Output.ai workflow: USGS earthquake data to a validated English news draft

scripts.output:worker: npm run output:worker:build && npm run output:worker:start
scripts.output:worker:watch: npx nodemon --watch src --ext ts,js,json,prompt,md --ignore 'dist/**' --ignore '**/*.spec.*' --ignore '**/*.test.*' --exec 'npm run output:worker'
